subject: CedarPoint onboarding: sandbox access, training & certification
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cedarpoint.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@cedarpoint.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CedarPoint onboarding: sandbox access, training & certification

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was excited about Redwood's latency and the private deployment options. We are starting a small pilot with one of our clients and want to get our SI engineers the right access and training. High level asks: 

- Temporary sandbox with sample logs/data (non-prod) for two engineers (VPN/VPC access)
- A 2-hour technical kickstart focused on deployment and runtime tuning
- The partner certification track and one quick self-study checklist so our PMs can track readiness
- Any pre-requisite architecture notes or limitations (e.g., supported quantization, max sequence lengths)

We are hoping to run the kickstart week of Aug 4. Can you confirm availability and what you need from us (IPs, contact names, NDA or form)?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Integrations
CedarPoint Consulting
elena@cedarpoint.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@cedarpoint.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPoint onboarding: sandbox access, training & certification

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: yes. Longer answer below and a short checklist so we can move quickly.

What we can provide right away:
- Short-lived sandbox VPC (isolated) with a preloaded sample dataset and a demo model instance — access for two engineers.
- A 2-hour remote technical kickstart (engineers + solutions lead) covering: deployment patterns, routing policies, batching/caching, and basic observability.
- Our partner certification guide + a lightweight "readiness checklist" (I attached our SI_Kickstart_Template.pdf) so you can track completion.

What we need from you to provision sandbox by Aug 1:
- Names + corporate emails of the two engineers for IAM invites
- A list of allowed IPs or CIDR ranges for the VPC peering/VPN
- A signed MSA/NDA if you want the sandbox to include any sample customer data (we can default to synthetic data)

I'm looping in Laura (partner programs) to scope the certification seats and Connor (field solutions) for the kickstart agenda. Proposed next step: quick 30-min sync tomorrow to confirm engineer names and calendar windows. Are you available 10–10:30am PT?

— Mateo Alvarez
Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@cedarpoint.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarPoint onboarding: sandbox access, training & certification

Elena — welcome, excited to work with CedarPoint. A few notes on certification and seats: 

- We have a three-level SI certification: Foundations (self-study), Deployment Lab (hands-on), and Accredited Partner (live eval). For the pilot, Foundations + Deployment Lab is usually sufficient.
- I can carve two Deployment Lab seats for Aug 5 or Aug 6 (45–90 min each). If you want both engineers in one session we can make it 2 hours.
- I've attached the M26_Jumpstart_Agenda.xlsx draft; Connor, please fill in the technical owner and slide deck links.

Also: we prefer DocuSign for the basic sandbox terms; Mateo, can you send the embedded link? 

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Thanks Laura and Mateo — 10/10 on the plan. Quick answers: 

- Engineer names: Priya Natarajan (priya@cedarpoint.com) and Rishi Malhotra (rishi@cedarpoint.com)
- Allowed IP: 52.23.144.0/27 (we'll open a VPN tunnel if you need it)
- NDA: happy to sign — please send the link.
- Preferred training date: Aug 5, afternoon PT if that works for your team.

We also have a short internal checklist we use to measure readiness (security review, admin access, workload samples). Happy to share if that helps align expectations.

Best,
Elena

1) Provisioning: Opening a request with infra to stand up an isolated sandbox VPC and two IAM accounts for Priya and Rishi. Target: Aug 1 by 5pm PT.
2) DocuSign: Mateo — I uploaded the standard sandbox terms and created an embedded sign request: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/embedded-sign/ABC123-cedarpoint (Elena, you'll get the email).
3) Training: We'll run a 2-hr combined session Aug 5 at 1:00pm PT. Agenda will cover: quick architecture overview, deployment patterns, tuning for throughput vs latency, KV caching demo, and a short Q&A. Laura — adding the deployment lab notes to the agenda.

Attachments included:
- SI_Kickstart_Template.pdf (partner-facing 1-pager + checklist)
- M26_Jumpstart_Agenda.xlsx (detailed agenda + owner columns)

Please confirm the 1pm PT slot and that the engineer emails are correct.

Connor O'Brien
